wording:21f385b6349a2c5622a55cac40785563.text: From 9 Nov 2026, finish your current buy now, pay later plans but don't start any new ones. That frees up £30/month for your card from month 2.

wording:fdb4bfefcbb0da0d3220497008f8555a.text: On 16 Nov 2026, move an energy or broadband account into your name. Your payments will then start building your credit file, as nothing like that is in your name yet.

wording:ca0ff5c833276705e7441bf2f7f9b891.text: On 1 Feb 2027, you could try a cheap SIM-only monthly phone plan. Vodafone said no recently, so wait until Boost and your other quick wins show. It helps build your credit history.

wording:903b91cb803a19adc7e0465a88e47ad2.text: On 9 May 2027, get your rent reported. Sign up to a rent-reporting service like CreditLadder for your £560 rent. It takes about 8 weeks to show on your credit report.

wording:0467f3c43ca1ee84aa2ed5af742db9d7.text: On 9 May 2027, check Capital One Classic on QuickCheck. It is a soft search, so it has no score impact. If it says yes, apply once. If no, wait 3 months.

wording:c0a6ecccff7adf6b9eb0ba605955c427.text: On 23 May 2027, move Amazon Prime Student £4.49 and Spotify Student £5.99 onto the Classic card. Set a Direct Debit for the full balance, so you pay £0 interest.

wording:04d12e179535d824946d6d45f3963cb0.text: From 9 Nov 2026, pause all credit applications until 9 Jan 2027. Each full application leaves a hard search on your report. To check a card safely, try Capital One QuickCheck. It has no score impact.

wording:e6c54375a84d5c5d4a3aed3ddfd7ac56.text: On 9 Nov 2026, connect Experian Boost. Link your current account in the Experian app. It can count Spotify Student, Amazon Prime Student and Uni gym as on-time payments. It can't lower your score.

wording:29aab6692d813e5f9b4559e133deb9cb.text: On 9 Nov 2026, stop taking out new buy now, pay later plans. Finish the ones you have. That frees up £30/month for your card from month 2.

wording:88d45c1b832eff728ff7dcaf32b02d45.text: On 16 Nov 2026, put a household bill in your name. Move your energy or broadband account over. Then your payments start building your credit file.

wording:f913b9a7bb4d277f05748264b337dd6d.text: From 1 Feb 2027, try a monthly phone contract again. Vodafone said no recently, so ask for a cheap SIM-only plan. It is a small credit agreement that helps build your history.
